allowed_changes: Replace the standalone audio and physical MIDI endpoint shell with a zero-input stereo VST3 processor that receives host buffers and host MIDI.
Expose the 178 source-musical controls through stable prototype-local parameters and adapt Controls::running to one additional persistent Run parameter.
Serialize the visible program, seed, page, and mode while resetting intentionally volatile Core, controller-edge, diagnostic, and impact-history state on recall.
Partition arbitrary positive host buffers and timestamped MIDI boundaries into consecutive Core calls no larger than 512 frames.
Reuse the musical editor topology without standalone Start Audio, refresh MIDI, or endpoint selection controls.
excluded: Host transport or tempo synchronization, note-trigger behavior, audio input, sidechain, MIDI output, recording or sample export, preset browser, and hidden Core state serialization.
Canonical implementation binding, provider, runtime, package, other plug-in formats or architectures, install, Live launch, endpoint or device access, listening, distribution, and production claims.
preserve: Pamplist Core DSP equations, fixed 48000 Hz timeline, deterministic addressed randomness, defaults, sanitization, smoothing, seven-lane decision and motion behavior, seven Macro Voices, dry mixer, cohesion body, and stereo Q27 output.
All source control domains, discrete quantization, labels, contextual page topology, channel-16 controller mappings, Clear generation semantics, and accepted-state activity reduction.
Exact configured Macro Voice source authority and byte-authentic upstream code without source checkout mutation.
Independent per-instance Core, controller, parameter, state, snapshot, and editor-history ownership.

intentional_deviations: Run is adapter parameter 179 so a host can automate and recall it; the canonical Run action remains semantically separate.
Clear is deliberately absent from parameters and serialized state to prevent action replay during recall.
State recall restores the program into a fresh Core rather than attempting to serialize hidden voice, timeline, cohesion, diagnostic, or history state.
Host buffers over 512 frames and timestamped CC positions are rendered as consecutive bounded Core calls.
The VST3 editor reuses fingerprinted musical presentation mechanics but excludes the standalone endpoint lifecycle shell.

The authenticated JUCE VST3 boundary adds one standard bypass parameter and 16 by 130 non-automatable MIDI-controller service parameters. They are wrapper protocol state, not Pamplist-owned musical or adapter parameters; the 179 stable Pamplist parameters remain first and exhaustive.
